basics.name: Edgars Nemše
basics.label: Chief Executive Officer, GenLayer Foundation
basics.summary: Edgars Nemše is Chief Executive Officer of the GenLayer Foundation and a co-founder of GenLayer, a network that resolves contracts and disputes between people, companies and AI agents, using a jury of different AI models. Product builder at heart: he likes to own a thing end to end, from deciding what to build to shipping it. Programming since he was 12, and over a decade at early-stage companies. Based in Portugal.

work.name: GenLayer Foundation
work.summary: Appointed September 2026, ahead of the token and mainnet launch. His focus is adoption, getting teams to build real products on intelligent contracts, and moving the foundation's own work (grants, treasury, governance) onto GenLayer itself.

work.name: GenLayer Labs
work.summary: Co-authored the GenLayer whitepaper and led the product from first prototype to public testnet: the blockchain's execution environment, the developer tools and the consensus design. Built and ran the product and developer-experience teams.

work.name: Millburn Ridgefield
work.summary: Researched and built systematic crypto trading strategies for an $8 billion quantitative investment manager in New York, using social-sentiment and on-chain data.

work.name: StakeHound
work.summary: Liquid staking protocol that reached $300 million staked across eight proof-of-stake blockchains. Designed the product and built the first version.

work.name: Radix DLT
work.summary: Early employee. Built the desktop wallet and the TypeScript library, and worked through the protocol's consensus design with the core team, experience he later brought to GenLayer. StakeHound started here as an internal product and was spun off.

work.name: Edurio
work.summary: School survey platform used by more than 600 schools and several ministries of education. Built it from the ground up as the only engineer for the first year, then grew the team to six.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Paid work from 16 through university: websites, interactive exhibits built on microcontrollers, sensors and cameras, cloud data pipelines.

projects.name: GenLayer
projects.description: Whitepaper, 2024. Co-author with Albert Castellana and José María Lago.

projects.name: GenLayer Studio, JavaScript SDK, CLI and testing suite
projects.description: The tools developers use to write and test intelligent contracts. Open source; he is the largest contributor to each.

projects.name: GenWorlds
projects.description: Open-source framework for multi-agent systems, built at YeagerAI with José María Lago in 2023. The stepping stone to GenLayer.

projects.name: Mergeproof
projects.description: A protocol where reviewers stake on pull requests. Built in a week, 2026.
